findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor. 

Boxes of food items were observed on the floor in the kitchen area as well as the dry storage area during the inspection. The PIC stated that the items were received a couple days prior. The situation was discussed and they were instructed to store all food items six inches above the floor to allow for cleaning and reduce pest concerns in the future.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored.
findings.citation_text:
3-304.14(B) Wiping Cloths, Use Limitation. (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be: (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114; and (2) Laundered daily as specified under 4-802.11(D).

A moist rag is observed on the counter int he back. The rag is being used for wiping down the surfaces in the kitchen. It should be held between uses in a sanitizer of sufficient concentration to prevent the growth of pathogenic organisms. The PIC was consulted and instructed to adjust their procedure moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT from the pre-opening) 6-101.11(A)(3) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (3) Nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture such as FOOD preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, WAREWASHING areas, toilet rooms, mobile FOOD ESTABLISHMENT SERVICING AREAS, and areas subject to flushing or spray cleaning methods.

Items remaining from the pre-opening that are in need of correction include: 1) Replace ceiling tiles in the kitchen and restrooms with smooth, easily cleanable surface-- vinyl ceiling tiles or gloss/semigloss paint. 2) Paint bare plywood and drywall edge above the utility sink. 3) Seal back door to eliminate daylight visible along the bottom edge. Repair/replace these items prior to the next routine inspection.
